snippet.title: Blackthorne's Manor Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on steam

Blackthorne's Manor is a first-person mystery thriller, where logic, puzzles, and the supernatural collide. Search for your missing friend, uncover the secrets of Blackthorne Manor, and escape before the house claims you too.

Blackthorne's Manor was created by Error 404, the team is comprised of 
Arnold Van Zyl - Programmer
Toby Tinker - Art Lead, VFX and Set Dresser
Jakob Woods - Level Design, SFX and Lore
Lydia-Aroha Farrant - 3D Modeling and Set Dresser
Roczen Juan - VFX, UI, Concepting
